Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ultra-premium recruitment service website hero background, wide 2.1:1 composition.
Input Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, our own existing ELEGSO architectural artwork. Create a NEW original image, not a screenshot or website mockup. Match its deep emerald marble, dark smoked glass, satin brass, ivory, cinematic side lighting, reflective floor and calm sophisticated architectural 3D rendering.
Primary request: communicate expert personnel selection and building a qualified business team through an elegant architectural sculpture. On the RIGHT 55% arrange three beautiful tall translucent smoked-glass candidate-profile frames at different depths, each containing a refined ivory three-dimensional abstract head-and-shoulders sculptural relief. Make them distinctly human but non-identifiable, neutral, unbranded, dignified, without facial stereotypes. A single selected front frame has a thin glowing brushed-brass perimeter and stands on an emerald marble plinth; two quieter frames behind indicate considered alternatives. Connect the plinths with a restrained sculptural brass arc, suggesting matching people to business needs. Add a few emerald vertical architectural columns around them, not an overcrowded office. No chess pawns, no conveyor belt, no literal selection cursor.
Composition: hero camera slight low three-quarter view, physically convincing depth, crisp editorial luxury materials, deep perspective and soft volumetric atmosphere. The entire LEFT 45% must be dark clean low-contrast negative space for live HTML text; no objects or bright reflections there. Candidate frames and full plinth fit within right area and margins so they can crop on phones. Lighting from upper right, warm brass edge highlights and cool emerald ambient bounce, subtle floor reflections.
Constraints: no Themis, no sword, no scales or courtroom, this is a recruitment landing separate from legal services. No real people, no fake employee photo, no logos, words, letters, numbers, badges, watermarks, UI, checkmarks or text. No pink/blue neon, no cheap stock handshake, no cartoon, no flat clipart. Preserve our brand language with a clearly new personnel-selection subject.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: supporting recruitment assessment illustration for a premium ELEGSO website, landscape 16:9.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY from our own approved brand artwork. Create a new original composition about careful professional evaluation. Match emerald marble, deep forest green, ivory and satin brass, architectural 3D realism, refined restrained luxury, strong dimensional materials, cinematic cool ambient light and warm edge light.
Scene: a close architectural still life of an elegant desk-like emerald stone platform. Three substantial smoked-glass profile folios stand at different depths; front folio has an embossed ivory neutral head-and-shoulders profile relief and several simple horizontal metal inlays instead of text, representing professional experience. A beautiful polished-brass optical lens positioned in front brings one crisp abstract competency pattern on the glass into focus. Nearby lie two neat ivory blank sheets and an understated brass pen, conveying examination of real work rather than a database of names. Subtle green architectural columns and a gold curve in the background connect it to the hero language.
Composition: all objects complete, three-quarter perspective, quiet balanced negative space, strong focal point on the lens and front folio. This is symbolic professional evaluation, no real employee photos, no courtroom. No Themis or sword. No words, letters, numbers, readable CV, logos, ticks, fake metrics, watermarks, UI, cartoon, handshake, chess pieces. Sophisticated high-quality photorealistic 3D render, not flat illustration.
